checklist.why: Hash-verified package with custody log for police/court.

checklist.title: Report each post to the platform as non-consensual intimate / morphed imagery
checklist.why: Platforms prioritise complaints from the depicted person about intimate or morphed images.

checklist.title: Create a StopNCII.org case from your own device
checklist.why: Blocks re-uploads on participating platforms without sharing the image.

checklist.title: Submit the NCRP complaint (cybercrime.gov.in) or call 1930
checklist.why: Starts official action; note the acknowledgement number here.

checklist.title: If platforms do not act, escalate to their Grievance Officer, then the Grievance Appellate Committee
checklist.why: Formal escalation route for intermediary complaints in India.

checklist.title: Enable monitoring for re-uploads and changes
